why: Quest asked for construction materials on the front page and has no photography of its own of them — Quest photographs jobs, not stock. These are the only photographs on the site Quest did not take.
rule: CC0 only. Public-domain dedication: commercial use permitted, no attribution required, no share-alike. Anything added here must carry the same, and build/lib/images.test.mjs enforces that every non-Quest image in the tree is listed in this file.

images.processing: Lightened and crushed on the way in (ffmpeg eq brightness=0.34 contrast=0.36) so the accent plane can sit over it as a tint rather than a lid. Chosen for the one property that survives a tint: big repeating shapes. Fine detail flattens first, which is why framing studs and small hats read as noise here and block courses do not. Monochrome by luck and kept that way — it takes the accent cleanly instead of muddying with it the way a red brick texture did.
